events.title: Locked-In: The Script is DONE!
events.summary: To all my dearest Parasocialites,I have the most excellent news: The story of ALL THE PROMISED BURN has been outlined, written, playtested, and edited. It is done. It is such a huge weight off my back. I am so pleased with how I've tuned it here, at the end. And if I were to suddenly die now, you could still understand the vision -- you could have the script, most of the art, the gameplay... why, you could even ASSEMBLE it without me! I could even RELEASE the game episodically into Early Access.

events.title: All the Promised Burn is OFFICIALLY in Development!
events.summary: How's it going?My friends and parasocial darlings, All the Promised Burn -- my hand-drawn knowledge-based RPG -- is officially in development! Please be excited to translate (fictional) dead languages into living ones, try cooking real recipes with fake food, and cry at the growing distance between you and the people you've left behind.
